安排下一班

限時：出門 1.5 秒後重返，不扣分、連擊中斷；重返不計費，倒數照走。操作設備時倒數照走，靠近與出射過場暫停，時間到老闆送客。不限時：出門結算。

開啟時，手機直拿也會把整個遊戲側轉；關閉則跟隨手機方向。

import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import * as T from '../public/games/overtime-pinball/vendor/three.module.min.js';import {createShadowWorkerVisuals} from '../public/games/overtime-pinball/shadow-worker-visual.js';
test('visuals cap at two, mirror x, never add lights and remove all on reset',()=>{const office=new T.Group(),v=createShadowWorkerVisuals({T,office});v.update([{id:1,x:4,z:8,vx:1,vz:2},{id:2,x:5,z:9},{id:3,x:6,z:10}],1);assert.equal(v.root.children.filter(c=>c.visible).length,2);assert.equal(v.root.children[0].position.x,-4);let lights=0;v.root.traverse(o=>{if(o.isLight)lights++});assert.equal(lights,0);const count=v.root.children.length;for(let i=0;i<100;i++)v.update([{id:1,x:i,z:0}],i);assert.equal(v.root.children.length,count);v.update([],0);assert.equal(v.root.children.filter(c=>c.visible).length,0);v.dispose();assert.equal(office.children.length,0)});
